notes.title: Exiting Early Access (release date + price increase)
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone. 

I have been developing Tower Knight for over a year, and it is almost ready to exit Early Access.

The expected release date will be Mid September, and the release price will be $6.99.

Tower Knight has come a long way.  When it first entered Early Access the deck building was based on a suit matching system, the graphics were in their very early stages, and there was zero audio.  It did, however, have the core idea ready to be played and ready to receive feedback.  Thanks to everyone's help, Tower Knight has developed into a game that I am excited to play, and watch others play.

Below is a gif from the latest release, and the first gif posted when Tower Knight entered Early Access.

notes.title: Update Trees and Ground
notes.notes: 0.9.5 is a visual update -- the trees are now 3D and the game is going back to using a flat grass ground instead of tiles and fog.

notes.title: Update world generation, improve deck building & graphics update
notes.notes:
This update improves world generation and gives the player 4 cards to choose from when a deck card is drawn, and updates the graphics quite a bit.

This update also improves the art style.

notes.title: Version 0.9.0 quiet release
notes.notes:
Version 0.9.0 introduces 9 challenge modes to choose from.  Challenges consist of different starting decks.

The maps and enemy locations are procedurally generated, and the generation parameters are slightly different for each challenge.

This is a quiet release because I am still making minor audio and graphics updates, but I couldn't wait to share these updates with you all.

Stay tuned for 0.9.1, which is when I will post more details about the changes and update the store page.

notes.title: Graphics Update
notes.notes:
v0.8.1 introduces the latest graphics updates.  The next v0.8.# releases are all going to be graphics and animation related.

I plan to start making v0.9 releases in July.  v0.9.# updates will start introducing challenge modes.

notes.title: Fast Mode + Update Starting Deck
notes.notes:
This minor update does the following:

[list]
[*] Adds a Rampart Card to your starting deck.
[*] Removes the Stones card (making room for a more meaningful card in a future update).
[*] Adds a fast mode, which makes the simulation speed of each wave 75% faster when enabled.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.6.1: Minor graphics update. Flags coming soon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983527/f7e06afcbdb7fe11dcc8764b3351abbf4055f327.png[/img]

A flag system is coming soon, and in preparation for designing the flags I needed to update the environment colors to more closely match what I am imagining for the environment when the game exits early access (still aiming for early Q4 of 2024).  

There is still a lot of work to do on the environment art, but I like the new grass textures, and the rock/grass effects when new tiles appear.  As a result, here is 0.6.1!

I am now dedicating the next week to flags.

Hope you enjoy.

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.5 (May 13)
notes.notes:
Version 0.5 makes the following updates and fixes:
[list]
[*] Update Trees asset to match the image on the Trees card
[*] Update Stones asset to match image on the Stones card
[*] Update range effect color to illustrate that tile height affects range
[*] Map arrow audio and "Wave intro music" audio to the correct audio bus so their volumes can be controlled with the settings sliders.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: 0.4: Graphics update and tips for new players
notes.notes: Version 0.4 includes a minor graphics update, and subtle tips for new players to learn about the suit system and winning the game.

notes.title: Version 0.3 (skipping 0.2)
notes.notes:
Development on Version 0.3 went smoothly so I decided to skip 0.2 and release 0.3 early.

0.3 Includes:
[list]
[*] Music
[*] Sound Effects
[*] Updated graphics
[*] A new "Destroy" card
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: May 2 Early Access Release & Developer Let's Play
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Y61wL01w1bU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi -- The Early Access release date for Tower Knight is set to [b]May 2nd[/b]!

[h1]Live Stream[/h1]
I have recently finished recording a live stream playtesting Tower Knight.  If you want to see a let's play of Tower Knight from me (the developer), or hear my take on strategies then checkout the video on YouTube.

This developer-playtest was recorded while I was testing the latest audio updates that I've been working on.  The initial Early Access release will not have audio, but I will post an update with sound effects 1 week after the release of 0.1.

[h1]Early Access[/h1]
Early Access Version 0.1 will be released on May 2nd, and I plan to release an update approximately every 1-2 weeks after that.

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Version 0.2 will include sound effects, and I expect to release it on May 9th.

Once version 0.2 is released I will decide which features will be in 0.3 and will post an announcement.

If you want to influence what will be in 0.3, then [b]join the discord[/b]! https://discord.com/invite/vMmVxYuYbg
